governance_guard_checks.description: All skeleton items must have ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] empty (empty string '', not absent). Single-object architecture ensures CorrectChoice and EW fields co-located — no CC-offset false positives. Verified via governance guard self-test and validator scan.
governance_guard_checks.test_assertion: Guard rejects item with non-empty EW[CC]

governance_guard_checks.description: All skeleton items must have non-empty non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slots. All three distractor EW slots must contain ≥50 characters of choice-specific text. Verified via governance guard self-test and validator scan.
governance_guard_checks.test_assertion: Guard rejects item with empty non-CC EW slot

governance_guard_checks.description: All 4 ExplanationWrong fields (A, B, C, D) must be present in every item object. The CorrectChoice slot may be empty; the three distractor slots must be non-empty (Rule 6). Verified via governance guard self-test and validator field-presence check.
governance_guard_checks.test_assertion: Guard rejects item with absent EW field

governance_guard_checks.description: Initial content authoring batches must not exceed 30 items per change-set without BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker. Phase 2 authoring produces 500 items per pack — must be committed in ≤30-item batches. Verified via governance guard self-test.
governance_guard_checks.test_assertion: Guard blocks writes with >30 question objects and no BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker

governance_guard_checks.description: Every question_state change (Unprocessed → In Audit, In Audit → Certified, etc.) must pair with a knowledge/REVISION_HISTORY.md entry. WARN-level (not BLOCK) — flagged at session idle.
governance_guard_checks.test_assertion: Guard warns when state changed without revision entry

governance_guard_checks.description: Any CorrectChoice or Correct value change must include a 'recomputed' or 'independently verified' note. WARN-level — flagged at session idle.
governance_guard_checks.test_assertion: Guard warns when CC changes without verification note

governance_guard_checks.check: Rule 9 — DL-037 Binary Lead-In Polarity BLOCK
governance_guard_checks.description: Choice text starting with 'Yes,' or 'No,' must align semantically with the conclusion clause. Pattern: 'No, ... should be investigated' is a polarity mismatch (should be 'Yes, ... should be investigated').
governance_guard_checks.test_assertion: Guard blocks 'No, ... should be investigated'; passes 'No, ... should not be investigated'

governance_guard_checks.description: Every P2 item must carry Part2OnlyFlag: true. Field must exist (typeof boolean), be strictly true (not 'true' string, not 1), and survive JSON round-trip. Absent or false → BLOCK certification. Part 1's governance guard has no equivalent rule — this is P2-specific.
governance_guard_checks.test_assertion: Guard rejects item without Part2OnlyFlag or with Part2OnlyFlag: false

governance_guard_checks.description: QID format must match /^P2-[A-F]-\d{3}$/. Any P1- prefix QID in a P2 pack → BLOCK. CaseID must match /^CBQ2\d?-[A-F]\d+$/. Any CBQ (without '2') CaseID → BLOCK. Verified via QID prefix check in validator and governance guard.
governance_guard_checks.test_assertion: Guard rejects P1-A-001 in pack_p2_a.js; rejects CBQ-A1 in case_pack_p2_1.js
